description: Canonical metadata for a game leaderboard, published in the game's own AT Protocol repository.

main.description: Defines one leaderboard offered by a game. Supports both simple single-integer arcade/speedrun boards (`scoreFormat` + `sortOrder`) AND rich multi-component boards (`components` + `defaultComponent`, e.g. Points + Time + Grade + Clear Lamp), legal chart/patch version filtering (`rankedVersions`), and multi-issuer post-EoS federation (`trustedIssuers`).

game.description: AT-URI of the game definition record (e.g. `games.atmosphere.define`) in the publisher's repository.

name.description: Display name of the leaderboard (e.g. `High Scores`, `Fastest Clear`, ` Freedom Dive [FOUR DIMENSIONS]`).

description.description: Optional explanation of what this leaderboard tracks and any rules.

icon.description: Required square icon or jacket art representing this leaderboard (512x512 PNG or WebP recommended).

iconAlt.description: Accessibility alt text for the leaderboard icon.

sortOrder.description: Primary ranking direction for single-metric boards (`largerIsBetter` for points; `smallerIsBetter` for speedruns).

scoreFormat.description: Formatting rules for single-value integer scores (`numeric`, `time`, or `currency`). Optional when `components` defines structured multi-component columns.

components.description: Optional dictionary map of component key (`record-key`, e.g. `ex-score`, `accuracy`, `lamp`, `clear-time`) to typed component definition (`#pointsComponentDef`, `#percentageComponentDef`, `#timeComponentDef`, `#enumComponentDef`, `#textComponentDef`). Forward-compatible with the proposed Lexicon `map` type.

componentOrder.description: Optional explicit display order of component keys in `components` (e.g. `["ex-score", "accuracy", "lamp", "clear-time"]`). Preserves author-intended column order across DAG-CBOR canonical map-key sorting.

defaultComponent.description: Key in `components` used as the default ranking column when `components` is present.

detailsSchema.description: Optional Lexicon `$type` or NSID hint indicating the structured breakdown object expected in `leaderboard.score#details` (e.g. `games.opengaming.defs#judgmentBreakdown` or a genre-specific lexicon).

rankedVersions.description: Optional list of leaderboard-legal chart, map, or game-build hashes/identifiers (e.g. MD5/SHA-256 hex digest of a chart file). When non-empty, active rankings filter out scores whose `version` is not in `rankedVersions`—preserving pre-patch runs in player PDSs without revoking them as cheated.

trustedIssuers.description: Optional list of additional DIDs authorized to sign score attestations for this leaderboard (e.g. federated tournament hosts or post-EoS community revival instances).

timeframes.description: Which leaderboard time windows this game tracks and displays for this board (`daily`, `weekly`, `allTime`).

recordPolicy.description: Controls how player `leaderboard.score` records are written: `bestOnly`, `perWindowBest`, or `everyRun`.

scoreMin.description: Optional minimum valid raw headline score.

scoreMax.description: Optional maximum valid raw headline score.

listOrder.description: Optional sort index controlling the display order among a game's leaderboards.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this leaderboard definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this leaderboard definition was last updated.
